source.horizontal_crs: EPSG:3857 tile grid, coordinates calculated by XYZ formula
source.vertical_datum: Source absolute elevations; heterogeneous AWS Terrain Tiles vertical datum is not independently surveyed or verified.
source.resampling: Bilinear in source Web Mercator pixel-centre coordinates after inverse UTM projection; no extrapolation.
source.attribution: Elevation: AWS Terrain Tiles / Mapzen, USGS, NASA/SRTM and contributors. Water: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0).

origin.name: 山西大剧院建筑轮廓形心
origin.method: Project the supplied building polygon to EPSG:32649, take area centroid, inverse-project

raster_mapping.pixel_footprint: Rectangle bounds describe pixel outer edges, not sample centres.
raster_mapping.three_js_loading: Decode original PNG Uint16 samples without browser 8-bit canvas conversion. Convert q to Float32 q/65535, then use THREE.DataTexture(RedFormat, FloatType), NoColorSpace, flipY=false. DataTexture row zero is original PNG row zero; shader north v=0 / south v=1. Keep the mask as a separate nearest-filtered scalar texture.
raster_mapping.three_js_vertex_mapping: For grid vertex (x,z), use u=(x-x_min)/(x_max-x_min), v=(z-z_min)/(z_max-z_min); sample linear height only over valid mask. At outer frame edge clamp to nearest VALID pixel centre, never blend NoData zeros.
raster_mapping.three_js_shader_decode: q=texture(height_map,uv).r*65535; elevation=min_m+(q-1)/65534*(max_m-min_m); y=elevation-scene_datum_elevation_m; discard/omit cells crossing valid_mask=0.
raster_mapping.mask_filtering: Nearest for categorical validity. Clip terrain to original_frame_scene_polygon or omit every cell with an invalid corner. NoData is not zero metres elevation.
raster_mapping.plane_geometry_note: PlaneGeometry rotated -PI/2 has north at default v=1; replace UV v with 1-v, or assign explicit north=0/south=1 UVs. Do not also flip the PNG.

scene_datum_note: DEM bilinear sample at theatre footprint centroid, animation alignment datum only; not measured finished floor level.

validity.nodata_reason: Outside the requested longitude/latitude frame, inside its enclosing projected UTM rectangle.

y_layer_alignment_note: Do not force whole DEM to water Y=-0.6: natural river/channel elevations vary. City Y=0 references theatre DEM datum; water layer remains director flat-layer convention.
